acceptanceCriteria: The owner promotes v0-5 to v0-7 in order, or records a decision on how published pre-releases relate to store promotion.
v0-8 reaches candidate and readiness reports its gates.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. `corvint-tasks release readiness` for v0-8 is BLOCKED only on candidate: all 14 tickets are complete, but `release candidate` refuses because its predecessors were never promoted (v0-5 is candidate only; v0-6 and v0-7 are not candidates). 0.7.0 and 0.8.0 were published as GitHub pre-releases without store promotion. Promotion is owner-only.
title: release chain: v0-5, v0-6 and v0-7 were never promoted, so v0-8 cannot become a candidate
